items.title: Judge halts Army’s plan to detonate 5 tons of bomb-making material as Iowa residents worry about lead exposure
items.brief: A federal judge has ordered the US Army to pause its plans to detonate five tons of lead azide on Monday after environmental activists filed a lawsuit expressing concerns about the potential impacts of the explosion.

items.title: Federal jury convicts man of starting the deadly 2025 Palisades Fire in Los Angeles
items.brief: The man accused of sparking last year’s deadly Palisades Fire was found guilty of arson charges Friday after his first federal case earlier this year ended in a mistrial .
